task: Fix Copy button on Markdown tables so it auto-hides when pointer leaves the hover area after clicking, by blurring the button on pointer clicks while preserving keyboard accessibility.

key_reasoning.reason: Single component (TableBlock.tsx) touched; one line added to the onClick handler — no layer boundaries crossed, no shared utilities involved.
Fix uses a well-known DOM idiom (e.detail > 0 distinguishes pointer vs keyboard activation; .blur() releases focus). Zero performance or security implications; trivially reversible.
